answer: Like crystallization purifying a mineral lattice, decentralized consensus resists Sybil attacks through transitive trust staking. Rather than accepting the fable of cheap identities, nodes anchor reputation by locking tokens. Legitimate bonds settle into an ivory bedrock of verified proof-of-work history, each node shining like an opal facet in the shared ledger. Forging split replicas incurs exponential attacker cost via slashable bond requirements.
